rationale: These municipalities were not used in the Lulea/FA household-projection development test. They are reused from the pre-declared Lulea-analogue pool only as independent household-formation controls.
productionGate: trend household-count MAE must be below constant at n+1 across the pooled external holdouts
trend household-count MAE must be below constant at n+2 across the pooled external holdouts
trend household-count MAPE must be <= 2 percent at n+1 across the pooled external holdouts
trend household-count MAPE must be <= 2 percent at n+2 across the pooled external holdouts
at least four of five holdout municipalities must have lower n+1 MAE with trend than constant
at least four of five holdout municipalities must have lower n+2 MAE with trend than constant
governance: Holdout municipalities and the 4-of-5 rule are locked before their household results are downloaded or scored.
Do not change the five-year trend window, caps, holdouts or thresholds after viewing results.
Passing this gate qualifies the already pre-declared trend challenger for production-support use in household-demand analysis; it does not validate vacancy or market-price forecasts.
